source: ابغاك تسوي لي لعبه انه لازم تنط عشان تاخذ فلوس يعني في سر تضغط عليه لاعبك الفيديو لما تضغط عليه لاعبك حينط وكل مكان الارتفاع اعلى كل ما كانت الفلوس اكثر ض\nواهم شيء يسوي مجسم للماب وكمان منظور الشخص هو منظور الشخص الثالث 3 دي وكمان ابغاك تضيف تطويرات يعني دي الفلوس وللج وكيف تجيب نقط الجنب من الشوب الشوب يعني شو اسمه تسوين مجسم كمان شوب يعني كذا سوي لي صوره مصغره جميله وكمان انه التطويرات قصدي كيف تجيب الجنب انك تتمرن لاعبك يعني في خمسه سايبك لعبك هيتمرن انه ينط هياخذ طاقه وكل واحده له ميزات يعني فينك تشتري واحد يدي 50 واحد اعلى ممكن واهم شيء يكون بت

image_prompt.text: A built shop area off to one side where jump upgrades are bought, with five distinct training kiosks
Barriers holding back the higher-value zones until they are bought
Walkable route linking the shop back to the base of the climb
A chain of platforms and ledges climbing upward, each tier higher than the last

layout_placement.text: Money pickups scattered on the platforms, worth more the higher up they sit
Five training stations where the player trains jumping, each granting a different jump boost

notes: The prompt is in Arabic and partly garbled; the reading taken is jump higher to collect more valuable money, spend it at a shop on five jump-training upgrades.

P6 validates platform spacing against default jump height, but the whole premise is buying jump power - the critical path here is meant to become reachable only after upgrades, which the generator cannot express.
A game thumbnail was requested; that is promotional art, not layout.

What do the five training stations each give, and what does the 50 refer to?

answers.ask: No theme was stated - should the climb be bright and cartoon, or something specific?
answers.answer: Make it bright and cartoon-style, with a colorful 3D climbing map and clear, friendly shop models.

answers.ask: Does 50 mean 50 jump power, 50 money, or 50 energy?
answers.answer: The 50 refers to energy: players can buy an option that gives 50 energy, while jumping/training uses energy and higher jumps earn more money.
